name: San Francisco
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in San Francisco for 2026, and here is what he found: 53 family events across San Francisco and 8 nearby towns, 19 of them free. The magic runs from November 4 (San Francisco on Ice) through January 31, with The Safeway Holiday Ice Rink in Union Square (November 4 to January 18), ZooLights (November 6 to January 3) and Holidays at Filoli (November 14 to January 10) along the way. New in this update: Lightscape at San Francisco Botanical Garden (November 20 to January 3), Panto in the Presidio: Down the Rabbit Hole at Presidio Theatre (November 28 to December 27) and Teddy Bear Tea at The Ritz-Carlton, San Francisco (November 28). We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our California Christmas events for kids guide.

What Rally found in San Francisco

  • 53 Christmas events for kids in San Francisco and 8 nearby towns, including Calistoga, Napa and Oakland
  • 19 free events, including Gingerbread House Lighting Ceremony, 2026 Holiday Tree Lighting and Holiday Lighting Celebration at Huntington Park
  • Meet Santa: 16 chances, including Santa Lights the Square (November 27 to December 18) and WinterFest at Six Flags Discovery Kingdom (November 27 to January 3)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Gingerbread House Lighting Ceremony (November 21 to December 31), Santa Lights the Square (November 27 to December 18) and 2026 Holiday Tree Lighting (November 28)
  • Also on the list: 16 Christmas shows, 12 Christmas light displays, 2 story times, 4 craft workshops and 2 ice rinks
  • Season: November 4 (San Francisco on Ice) to January 31 (Glowfari)
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site on Nov 25
